comparators.input: Effects typed compound list, inherited timer, energy, inventory/filter, radius/entityFilter
comparators.output: reconstructs nonnull effects, restores inherited remaining time and paid energy/inventory
comparators.preservation: Full writer/base timer read and write/pullFromItem/tick/affectEntities reviewed. Pull consumes one potion into copied effect list and timer budget; restored effects are actually applied while timer remains, so this is paid resource state, not generic inventory wrapper. Same owner counted once.
comparators.application_limit: Effects absent retains previous list; unbounded entityFilter ordinal can throw before base timer restored; missing radius becomes0. Newer NeoForge component API is research only; timed effects must not enter Dynasty permanent whitelist.

comparators.input: potionData codec, currentFill amount, locked type preference
comparators.output: optional saved potionData decoded; scalar amount and lock restored; item component transfers contents/amount/lock together
comparators.preservation: Read full tile and ANCodecs encode/decode bodies. remove empties potion data only when unlocked, preserving locked chosen type at0 amount; component collection explicitly retains locked empty jars. Count and semantic contents must be verified together.
comparators.application_limit: Codec parse getOrThrow, no fallback for bad potionData; absent potionData keeps old data on reused object. Missing fill0, no load clamp. Save TODO potionNames list is not implemented, cannot claim quest string support.

comparators.input: ItemStack-derived namespaced ID+tag string key, remaining Time and TotalTime
comparators.output: positive remaining times written; two-field CooldownInstance restored by key without starting a new full duration
comparators.preservation: Coordinator004 plus full FocusCooldown and SEHelper relevant writer/read bridge read. Class explicitly prevents relog reset. tick decrements remaining time/removes expired; percent uses time/totalTime. Distinct specific stack key disk implementation from already accepted player Clone setCooldowns reference transfer; general numeric Item-ID map support0, not second credit.
comparators.application_limit: No clear before reused load; per-element cast unguarded. keyOf uses tag string representation, not canonical persistent UUID identity; generic neighboring reader uses Item.byId numeric IDs unsuitable stable alias. This is duration remaining, not absolute deadline. Existing Dynasty PlayerPersisted owner remains sole cooldown authority.

proposals.mechanism: Server menu uses same physical item capability single-slot handler to install existing drinkable potion/brew; item factory owns lazily created handler. Complete capability pair delegates original ItemStack disk codec, preserving actual bottle effects rather than minting replacement. Actual server curio activation selects first equipped IActivatable; nonshift guard reads installed bottle and player cooldown. It resolves standard potion and custom brew payload and applies copied normal effects/instant effects/custom block effects. Bottle is not consumed, depleted or replaced. Adds shared item-type cooldown with amount based on ordinary potion effect potency/capacity. Thus installed bottle is reusable ability entitlement, not finite stored doses. Separate share-tag mirror writes cap and applies same handler decoder when nonnull.
proposals.dedup: Native14f8 already owns typed handler original stack codec. ProjectE cc514 already covers installed physical implement -> repeated gameplay effect under cooldown; Goety939 already covers actual player focus cooldown pair and lifetime boundary. EternalCauldron adds another portable vessel and effect payload, but no old alias/owner routing, spent-resource transfer or independent persistence mechanism beyond these accepted owners. Brew helpers and share-tag null asymmetry remain useful negative support0. Potion-jar/effect-beacon finite consumable budgets and world-numbered witch robe are contrasted, not claimed identical. Whole owner recommend0; each effect/bottle/helper/reader0.
limits: Handler restore trusts saved Size, so malformed zero slots can make getSlot(0) throw; larger Size loads extra custody not exposed by this one-slot menu. Load bypasses isItemValid and per-slot count limit; disallowed item payload can be restored. Capability unchecked casts CompoundTag and handler type. This is not validated migration or bounded safe fallback.

readShareTag(null) clears only root tag, leaving existing handler/capability bottle intact. Nonnull missing cap delegates empty compound and clears stored contents while retaining previous handler Size; root tag set afterwards. Do not treat null and missing cap as same reset or call share-tag the sole disk authority.

getShareTag reuses existing stack.getTag and puts cap into that actual mutable root; absent root allocates new compound without local setTag. Disk ForgeCaps and root cap mirror can coexist; no reconciliation/version key observed. ItemStack constructor gathers capability then applies actual ForgeCaps, whereas network readShareTag directly overwrites handler. Framework dispatcher internals not expanded.

No explicit onContentsChanged writeback/owner inventory dirty hook in this handler/capability. Actual disk save serializes live cap when invoked, but bounded source does not establish immediate flush or crash consistency after menu insertion. Native menu merge/SlotItemHandler internals and save scheduling unexpanded.

Menu validity checks only nonempty captured stack, not current player ownership/slot. quickMoveStack successful deposit branch returns EMPTY before cleanup/onTake, static observation only, no claim of reproduced duplication. Client menu is empty dummy handler and EMPTY stack; server captured original is authoritative.

No activation potion shrink or item payment: requirement to preserve paid resource means preserving already owned bottle, not claiming each use charged. This trace starts at actual menu installation of existing bottle, not full crafting recipe/payment history of every potion. Native mob effect internals/custom brew subclasses were not expanded; exact gameplay behavior and registry corruption not tested.

Cooldown is shared by item type for this activation, not per original physical bottle; later bottle swap does not reset it in observed methods. Timer duration multiplier only loops ordinary PotionUtils effects, custom-only brew effects do not contribute here. Arithmetic/default validation absent; generic cooldown pair stores numeric Item IDs and load does not clear maps. Already939 support, no new count.

Curio key selects first equipped IActivatable rather than specifically EternalCauldron. Native Curios library and packet registration not expanded; dispatcher and findCurio body inspected. No game, build, production changes, network, commit or push.
